social-publisher is a small personal tool by Ziyue Li. It uploads the explainer videos I make to my own YouTube channel (and to a few other platforms) from my Mac, with Claude as the assistant that prepares each post.

It is not a public service. It has no accounts, no sign-up and no other users. It runs only on my own computer.

## What it does

- It uploads a video file from my Mac to my own YouTube channel, with the title, description and tags that I approve.
- It reads my channel name, so I can check that I am signed in to the correct channel.
- I review and approve every post before it is published. Nothing is posted automatically.

## Privacy
